title: The wasm export matches the CLI export for every example
description:
As a maintainer, I want the browser export and the CLI export to agree byte for byte, so that one set checker proves both.

```gherkin
Feature: Browser and CLI exports agree
  Scenario: Every example
    Given every score under examples/ and the samples they use
    When the wasm export and "apricity export --daw-set" run on each
    Then every pair of set files is byte-identical
    And every set passes the set checker

  Scenario: Deterministic output
    When the wasm export runs twice on the same score
    Then the two set files are byte-identical
```
